question: Can every local operation be correct under its local contract while the requested scientific-state transition is unwarranted, and does M (orion_v2 registered transition logic: problem contract, typed obligations, provenance, dependence, typed transport, evaluator contract, atlas gluing, authority ceiling, selective reopening) make the exact registered transition decision beyond the strongest faithful parent federation B5 given the same registered information?
pre_registered_expectation: Once every cross-transition condition is a typed, witness-level module output crossing the federation boundary, B5 with ordinary engineering glue (JTMS shared state + the registered precedence table) computes the same decision function as M; the expected route is PARENT_SUFFICIENT with ladder terminal RESIDUAL_IS_INTERFACE_STANDARD_NOT_CONTROL (as ME-X4 found on its protected split). The decisive content is (a) whether any family breaks this by exposing a composition error in B5, (b) where single baselines B0-B4 break (attribution), (c) where along the H-EXT-3 ladder the gap appears (prediction: at the R4->R5 step, where identity/criterion/specification, atlas and authority witnesses first cross the boundary; plus the separation pair at R1), (d) anti-conservatism, (e) cost.

registered_information.state: claims (context, failure class, scope, criterion id, accepted_v0, intended spec id, global-section witness id, target epoch); evidence (claim, source, context, scope coverage, evaluator, calibration, data/instrument, supports, identity status); support families (evidence ids, prerequisite claims, min_independent, required_relation); sources VALID/RETRACTED/DISPUTED; calibrations VALID/INVALID/UNDER_REVIEW; evaluators (coverage, uncertain, status VALID/INVALID/UNDER_REVIEW); typed context relations (orion_v2.structural.RelationType); dependence declarations CONFIRMED/SUSPECTED; overlaps (compatible True/False/None + witness); criterion-equivalence table EQUIVALENT/NOT_EQUIVALENT/CANNOT_CHECK; spec-fidelity table FAITHFUL/UNFAITHFUL/UNCHECKED; results (bound claim, basis evidence, context, evaluator, proved spec, checker status, binding status, comparability status, independence requirement, required relation); authority policy (ceiling level NONE<BELIEF<OPERATIONAL<EXTERNAL, status)
registered_information.request: TransitionRequest(kind in ACCEPT_RESULT / PROPAGATE_DEFEAT / CLOSE_GLOBAL, target claim, result id, decision criterion id, required authority level, challenged event index)
registered_information.hidden_from_arms: the oracle implementation and the expected decisions (custody file); no answer key is encoded in the instance schema (every field is a registered status, never an action)

decision_object: (action, reopened commitment set); the set is non-empty only for SELECTIVELY_REOPEN; exactness = both equal

precedence: IDENT: identity binding (REVALIDATE), decision criterion (REFORMULATE_PROBLEM), spec fidelity (REVALIDATE), proof checker (REQUEST_NEW_EVIDENCE)
PROV: basis source (REQUEST_NEW_EVIDENCE), basis identity recoverability (REVALIDATE), basis calibration (REVALIDATE), comparability (REVALIDATE)
DEP: independence of the result basis (REQUEST_NEW_EVIDENCE)
ATLAS: local piece support (REQUEST_NEW_EVIDENCE), overlap compatibility (REFORMULATE_PROBLEM), global-section witness (REFORMULATE_PROBLEM when resolved absent)
AUTH: ceiling >= required (ABSTAIN_AUTHORITY); checked last so that ABSTAIN_AUTHORITY means 'epistemically warranted, not authorized'

atoms.identity:R: UNKNOWN if binding unrecoverable; VALID iff bound claim == target
atoms.criterion:T: VALID iff decision criterion == registered criterion or registered EQUIVALENT; UNKNOWN if CANNOT_CHECK; INVALID if NOT_EQUIVALENT or unregistered
atoms.spec:R: formal results: VALID iff proved == intended or registered FAITHFUL; INVALID if UNFAITHFUL; UNKNOWN if unassessed
atoms.src:e / ident:e / cal:e: per basis (and support-graph) evidence: source RETRACTED -> INVALID, DISPUTED -> UNKNOWN; identity UNRECOVERABLE -> UNKNOWN; calibration INVALID -> INVALID, UNDER_REVIEW -> UNKNOWN
atoms.comparability:R: present iff registered: NONCOMPARABLE -> INVALID, CANNOT_CHECK -> UNKNOWN
atoms.support:R / ind:F: present iff min_independent > 0: components over CONFIRMED dependence < k -> INVALID; over CONFIRMED+SUSPECTED < k -> UNKNOWN
atoms.transport:R / tr:F:e: present iff contexts differ: no relation -> INVALID; CANNOT_CHECK -> UNKNOWN; rank(relation) >= rank(required) -> VALID
atoms.evaluator:R / evc:e: status INVALID -> INVALID; UNDER_REVIEW -> UNKNOWN; failure class in coverage -> VALID; in uncertain -> UNKNOWN; blind with a registered valid alternative covering the class -> INVALID (replace); blind with no alternative -> UNKNOWN (cannot check)
atoms.piece:c: derived: Kleene support of the local claim over the support graph
atoms.overlap:o: compatible True -> VALID, False -> INVALID (obstruction), None -> UNKNOWN
atoms.witness:T: global-section witness registered -> VALID else UNKNOWN (MATCHING_FAMILY_ONLY is not a global section)
atoms.authority: policy UNDER_REVIEW -> UNKNOWN; ceiling >= required -> VALID else INVALID
atoms.nocontra:c: valid negative evidence -> INVALID; censored -> UNKNOWN

oracle_semantics.support_graph: ME-X4 semantics: family = AND(atoms) AND prerequisites; claim = OR(families) AND nocontra; Kleene three-valued bottom-up over the prerequisite DAG
oracle_semantics.accept_or_close: precedence walk with the singleton rule: the action is the one taken under EVERY resolution of the censored atoms (first INVALID atom's action, UPDATE if none); otherwise DEFER_CANNOT_CHECK
oracle_semantics.propagate_defeat: R = commitments unsupported under every resolution, U = commitments whose support depends on the resolution: U non-empty -> DEFER_CANNOT_CHECK; R non-empty -> SELECTIVELY_REOPEN(R); else PRESERVE
oracle_semantics.exhaustive_cross_check: every instance: the walk / Kleene decision must equal exhaustive enumeration over all 2^u resolutions of the censored base atoms (u <= 8 by generator cap); disagreement is a lane defect (G0b)

generator.base_state: 3-6 accepted claims in <= 3 prerequisite layers; 1-2 families per claim; 1-3 evidence per family (prerequisite-only 20%); 4-6 sources + one unused; 2 instruments x 1-2 calibrations + one unused; 3 evaluators (ev0 full coverage); typed relations among 3 contexts (70%); k=2 on 30% of >=2-evidence families; criterion K_<claim>, intended spec SPEC_<claim>; authority ceiling OPERATIONAL
generator.pre_event_validity: every accepted claim supported with all support atoms VALID at v0 (checked by the oracle; failing states rejected)
generator.planting: per-family planter builds the request and mutates the state / emits 0-3 events for the scheduled variant; the family invariant (action, decisive atom, reopened membership, decoy non-membership) is checked by the exact oracle; deterministic rejection sampling under the instance seed (max 400 attempts)
generator.variant_schedule: index mod 10 -> POSITIVE,NEGATIVE,AMBIGUITY,POSITIVE,NEGATIVE,POSITIVE,POSITIVE,NEGATIVE,POSITIVE,AMBIGUITY (50/30/20 per 100; first four indices POS,NEG,AMB,POS)

X1-A_CLAIM_PROBLEM_IDENTITY.positive: result bound to a sibling claim with identical output (REVALIDATE, decisive identity) or decision criterion not the registered/equivalent one (REFORMULATE_PROBLEM, decisive criterion)
X1-A_CLAIM_PROBLEM_IDENTITY.negative: correct binding with identical output; registered EQUIVALENT criterion; decoy event (UPDATE)
X1-A_CLAIM_PROBLEM_IDENTITY.ambiguity: binding unrecoverable / basis evidence identity lost (X1-DEV-014) / criterion equivalence CANNOT_CHECK (DEFER_CANNOT_CHECK)

X1-B_MEASUREMENT_CALIBRATION.positive: basis calibration invalidated or comparability NONCOMPARABLE (REVALIDATE)
X1-B_MEASUREMENT_CALIBRATION.negative: sibling calibration of the same instrument invalidated but unused by the basis; or registered ontic TARGET_CHANGED with comparability COMPARABLE (UPDATE)

X1-C_HIDDEN_DEPENDENCE.positive: PROPAGATE_DEFEAT: target's only family needs k=2 and the discovered dependence defeats it; decoy dependence elsewhere leaves k satisfied or has no requirement (SELECTIVELY_REOPEN, target in, decoy out); or ACCEPT_RESULT whose basis needs k=2 (REQUEST_NEW_EVIDENCE)
X1-C_HIDDEN_DEPENDENCE.negative: independent second family remains or k still satisfied (PRESERVE)

X1-D_INVALID_TRANSPORT.positive: donor-context result whose relation is retyped below the required strength or absent; decoy relation retyped elsewhere (BLOCK_TRANSPORT)
X1-D_INVALID_TRANSPORT.negative: typed valid transport (relation rank >= required); decoy weakening of another relation (UPDATE)

X1-E_DEFEATED_PREREQUISITE.positive: every sufficient route of the target shares a retracted source, or the target is the sole prerequisite of a downstream claim (SELECTIVELY_REOPEN incl. dependents)
X1-E_DEFEATED_PREREQUISITE.negative: one route retracted, an independent sufficient route remains (X1-DEV-007) (PRESERVE)

X1-F_EVALUATOR_BLINDNESS.positive: result's evaluator constructed without the claim's failure class while a registered valid alternative covers it; or the evaluator's validity contract invalidated (REPLACE_OR_CHALLENGE_EVALUATOR)
X1-F_EVALUATOR_BLINDNESS.negative: evaluator covers the class; decoy narrowing of an unused evaluator (UPDATE)
X1-F_EVALUATOR_BLINDNESS.ambiguity: class re-scoped to one no evaluator covers (X1-DEV-009) / coverage uncertain / evaluator under review (DEFER_CANNOT_CHECK)

X1-G_AUTHORITY_MISMATCH.positive: operational or external adoption requested above the ceiling (ABSTAIN_AUTHORITY; belief update warranted)
X1-G_AUTHORITY_MISMATCH.negative: requested level within the ceiling or ceiling raised (UPDATE)

X1-H_PROOF_WRONG_SPECIFICATION.positive: checker VALID on a statement registered UNFAITHFUL to the intended specification (REVALIDATE, decisive spec); or checker INVALID on a faithful statement (REQUEST_NEW_EVIDENCE, decisive checker)
X1-H_PROOF_WRONG_SPECIFICATION.negative: identical specification or registered FAITHFUL refinement with checker VALID (UPDATE)

X1-I_LOCAL_COMPAT_GLOBAL_OBSTRUCTION.positive: 2-3 local pieces with an explicit incompatible overlap = GLOBAL_SECTION_OBSTRUCTED (REFORMULATE_PROBLEM)
X1-I_LOCAL_COMPAT_GLOBAL_OBSTRUCTION.negative: all overlaps compatible and a separate global-section witness registered (UPDATE)
X1-I_LOCAL_COMPAT_GLOBAL_OBSTRUCTION.ambiguity: all overlaps compatible, witness absent = MATCHING_FAMILY_ONLY (X1-DEV-012) / an overlap unresolved (DEFER_CANNOT_CHECK)

X1-J_FULLY_WARRANTED.positive: ACCEPT_RESULT (plain / transported with adequate relation / operational within ceiling / formal faithful) with 1-2 decoy events (UPDATE)
X1-J_FULLY_WARRANTED.negative: PROPAGATE_DEFEAT with a partial family failure, k-satisfied dependence or unrelated retraction (PRESERVE)
X1-J_FULLY_WARRANTED.ambiguity: censoring on unrelated entities only (disputed unused source, unused calibration under review, suspected dependence in a family without requirement): UPDATE/PRESERVE, never DEFER

seed_commitment.custody: operator custody outside the repository: ~/.orion-custody/me-x1/PROTECTED_SEED_V1.txt (mode 600); the runner checks sha256(seed) == commitment before any protected generation
seed_commitment.reveal: the seed string is appended to the outcome receipt after the protected run; anyone can then regenerate the split byte-for-byte

power.primary_statistic: paired instance-level exact transition decision (action and reopened set) M vs B5; exact two-sided binomial test on discordant pairs (McNemar exact); estimand = P(M exact) - P(B5 exact) with a paired Wald interval
power.mde_pooled: 6 one-directional discordant instances (0.6%) reach exact p = 0.031; 8 reach p = 0.008
power.mde_per_family: n=100: 5 one-directional discordants (5%) reach p = 0.0625, 6 reach p = 0.031; per variant within a family (50/30/20) the test is reported, not gated
power.note: the prior expectation is zero discordance; the test is two-sided so a B5 advantage is equally detectable

arms.B0_DIRECT: local task system: ACCEPT/CLOSE -> UPDATE unless the local checker fails (REQUEST_NEW_EVIDENCE); PROPAGATE_DEFEAT -> PRESERVE
arms.B1_CALIBRATED_ABSTENTION: B0 plus an untyped uncertainty gate: any non-nominal or changed registered status in the request lineage -> DEFER_CANNOT_CHECK
arms.B2_PROVENANCE_PLUS_VERIFIER: orion_v2.provenance revocation descendants over the execution graph (sources, calibrations, evaluators, relations, target epochs -> evidence, families, results, claims) + local verifier; artifact-lineage identity (basis evidence must belong to the target); two-valued; actions REVALIDATE / REQUEST_NEW_EVIDENCE / SELECTIVELY_REOPEN(affected) / UPDATE / PRESERVE
arms.B3_PARENT_NATIVE_ASSURANCE: GSN change-impact over the registered argument with typed context elements (evaluator, calibration, relation, authority, spec, criterion, overlaps, witness); AND semantics; challenged goal -> REVALIDATE (re-argue) or reopen; two-valued
arms.B4_PARENT_MODULES_WITH_SHARED_STATE: typed provenance/dependence/transport/evaluator modules (TMS federation) with JTMS shared state and the registered precedence glue; identity by artifact lineage only (no criterion, no spec fidelity); pairwise compatibility taken as global (no atlas witness); no authority module
arms.B5_R1_VERDICT_ONLY: all seven parents typed; every module exports one per-claim (support) and one per-request verdict atom (INVALID if it defeats every family / any request condition; UNKNOWN if censored; else VALID) carrying the module default action (IDENT/PROV -> REVALIDATE, DEP -> REQUEST_NEW_EVIDENCE, TRANS -> BLOCK_TRANSPORT, EVAL -> REPLACE_OR_CHALLENGE_EVALUATOR, ATLAS -> REFORMULATE_PROBLEM, AUTH -> ABSTAIN_AUTHORITY); JTMS propagation with envelope
arms.B5_R2_PROV: rung 2: provenance records (source / identity / calibration / comparability witnesses) cross the boundary; other modules verdict-level
arms.B5_R4_PROV+DEP+TRANS+EVAL: rung 4: + typed transport and evaluator witness statuses
arms.B5_STRONGEST_FAITHFUL_PARENT_FEDERATION: rung 5: full structure (every witness incl. identity/criterion/spec/checker, atlas pieces/overlaps/witness, authority) = everything M sees; primary comparator
arms.M_ME_TRANSITION_CONTROL: orion_v2.contracts.ProblemContract (identity, scope, authority requirements) + one typed Obligation per cross-transition condition (SATISFIED / DEFEATED / CENSORED / AUTHORITY_BLOCKED) fed by the parent-owned reference modules (orion_v2.provenance, orion_v2.evidence.assess_evidence_dependence, orion_v2.structural.RelationType, orion_v2.comparability.ComparabilityCertificate, orion_v2.epistemic_atlas.assess_atlas_gluing) + orion_v2.reopening.selective_reopen optimistic/pessimistic envelope + the registered precedence walk to a Terminal; no answer key
arms.M_MINUS_PROBLEM_IDENTITY: identity, criterion and spec-fidelity conditions removed (checker kept)
arms.M_MINUS_EVALUATOR_CONTRACT: evaluator coverage contract removed; only the validity status remains
arms.M_MINUS_TRANSPORT: typed transport removed (donor results reused freely)
arms.M_MINUS_SUPPORT_REOPENING: support families merged into one AND family per claim (no selective reopening)
arms.M_MINUS_UNRESOLVED_TERMINAL: censored conditions treated as satisfied (no DEFER_CANNOT_CHECK)
arms.M_MINUS_MEASUREMENT_COMPARABILITY: beyond protocol S6 (ninth ablation, added because family B has no omission-specific ablation in the eight): calibration and comparability conditions removed
arms.M_MINIMAL_RECEIPT: atom kinds dropped by the development-frozen rule below
arms.C_RANDOM_ACTION: uniform random action (random reopened subset for SELECTIVELY_REOPEN); seed = instance seed ^ 0x5EED

m_minimal_receipt.rule: development split only: backward elimination over atom kinds in reverse precedence order (authority, witness, overlap, piece, evaluator, evc, tr, transport, ind, support, comparability, cal, ident, src, checker, spec, criterion, identity, nocontra); a kind is dropped iff M restricted to the remaining kinds stays exact on every development instance; frozen here before the protected run
m_minimal_receipt.note: the development split (4 per family) does not exercise every sub-variant; the protected split measures what a receipt minimised on development loses

b5_information_matching: B5 receives the identical state, event history, request and accepted list; its modules are the same parent implementations M's obligations are fed by (each passing native known-answer tests); engineering glue (verdict/witness export, JTMS envelope, the registered precedence table) is allowed; B5 is never artificially isolated

primary: exact transition decision (action and reopened set)
missed warranted update (oracle UPDATE, arm != UPDATE)
evaluator laundering (oracle decisive module EVAL, arm UPDATE)
problem/specification laundering (oracle decisive module IDENT, arm UPDATE)
correct unresolvedness (oracle DEFER and arm DEFER)
unnecessary defer/abstain rate (oracle not DEFER/ABSTAIN: arm DEFER/ABSTAIN)
cost (module + engine ops; wall-clock in a separate timing file)
per-family and per-variant tables (a pooled average cannot hide a catastrophic family)
secondary: B5 ladder rung exact rates and paired step tests (H-EXT-3)
assigned-label permutation null for M (mean over 200 permutations) with the chance agreement (sum of squared action frequencies)

G0a_KNOWN_ANSWER.rule: the 14 public development fixtures (X1-DEV-001..014) and the separation pair are reproduced by the oracle, and M and B5 are exact on all of them (selftest)

G0b_ORACLE_SELF_AGREEMENT.rule: precedence walk / Kleene support == exhaustive enumeration on every instance; every instance valid at v0; family invariants satisfied at generation

G0c_NULL_CALIBRATION.rule: C_ALWAYS_UPDATE exact = 0 where the oracle is not UPDATE/PRESERVE; C_ALWAYS_DEFER exact = 0 where the oracle is determinate; C_RANDOM exact <= 20%; M vs permuted oracle decisions (mean over 200 permutations) exact <= 35% (chance agreement reported)

G1a_B5_REPRODUCES_M.rule: M and B5 decisions identical on >= 99.5% of instances and no family > 5% discordant

G1b_M_ADVANTAGE.rule: paired exact difference M - B5 > 0 with exact two-sided p <= 0.05 and >= 1 family with >= 5 M-only-exact instances

G2_ANTI_CONSERVATISM.rule: M's unnecessary defer/abstain count <= B5's and M's warranted-transition recall >= B5's (warranted = every NEGATIVE variant and family J)

G3_MECHANISM.rule: evaluated only if G1b: for each family with >= 5 M-only-exact instances the matching omission ablation's exact rate on that family <= B5's (A,H -> MINUS_PROBLEM_IDENTITY; B -> MINUS_MEASUREMENT_COMPARABILITY; C -> MINUS_DEPENDENCE; D -> MINUS_TRANSPORT; E -> MINUS_SUPPORT_REOPENING; F -> MINUS_EVALUATOR_CONTRACT; G -> MINUS_AUTHORITY; I,J -> MINUS_UNRESOLVED_TERMINAL)

G4_INTERFACE_LADDER.rule: H-EXT-3: (a) no rung k+1 significantly worse than rung k (paired exact p <= 0.05 in the wrong direction is a violation); (b) rung-5 gap = the G1 paired test

COST.rule: wall-clock ratio with a 2x flag; reported, never a route by itself

routing_preregistered.G0_fail: CANNOT_CHECK (lane defect: repair, re-freeze, no arm verdict)
routing_preregistered.G1b_pass_G2_pass_G3_fail: CANNOT_CHECK (advantage not attributable to a named cross-transition condition)
routing_preregistered.neither_G1a_nor_G1b: PARENT_SUFFICIENT (B5 not worse, or discordance without significance)

field_support_rule_S10: X1 supports a nontrivial residual only if at least one protected family satisfies all of: (1) B5 has the information and parent mechanisms locally (true by construction: every module is typed and witness-level at rung 5); (2) B5 makes a systematic composition error (G1b with >= 5 M-only-exact in that family); (3) M avoids it because of a predeclared cross-transition condition (the decisive module of the oracle); (4) the matching omission ablation restores the error (G3); (5) the effect transfers to an independently authored / native-reviewed family (the separate naturalistic cell; not this study); (6) M does not obtain the gain by over-conservatism (G2). Otherwise X1 is at most a benchmark/integration result: PARENT_SUFFICIENT is the pre-registered expectation and a valid terminal.

separation_example.family: composition of dependence and transport defeats across families (H-EXT-3 finite separation, ME-X4 P/Q recast as a PROPAGATE_DEFEAT transition)
separation_example.P: claim c: F1 = {e1, e2 | k=2}, F2 = {e3 transported ctx1->ctx0, requires PREDICTIVELY_EQUIVALENT}
separation_example.Q: claim c: F1 = {e1, e2, e3 transported | k=2 over e1,e2}, F2 = {e4 native}
separation_example.claim: every federation whose module boundary carries only family-anonymous verdicts emits identical outputs for P and Q and errs on one of them; witness-level exchange is exact on both (P: SELECTIVELY_REOPEN {c}, Q: PRESERVE)
separation_example.selftest_check: verdict-only rung identical on P and Q and errs; rung 5 and M exact on both

naturalistic_transfer_S9: declared a SEPARATE later cell: at least two independently authored / native-reviewed case families from materially distinct modes (formal mathematics / software verification; measurement science; evidence synthesis); native reviewers define the protected decision and the strongest parent before seeing arm outcomes; nothing from this exact study transfers to it
no_rescue_clause: No family weight, oracle rule, precedence, arm, seed, or gate may change after the protected results file exists. Development-split tuning surface: bug fixes to arm glue validated by G0a known-answer tests before the seed is revealed. A protected result cannot be re-run under a new seed; a lane defect found mid-run halts the lane, is receipted, and re-freezes with a new design version.

custody.protected_authorization: PROTECTED_RUN_AUTHORIZATION.json with human_written=true, human_written_token (>= 16 chars), acknowledged_design_sha256 == sha256 of this JSON; absent at design freeze
custody.determinism: byte-identical results on re-run (only RNGs: instance seeds, C_RANDOM_ACTION seed, shuffle-null seed 20260902)
